mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO material_sections ( user_id, material_id, file_hash, analysis_version, chunk_index, unit_type, unit_start, unit_end, printed_page_start, printed_page_end, section_label, display_title, roles_json, task_text, excerpt, assignment_cue, assignment_quote, date_candidates_json, dedupe_key, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{materialId}, #{fileHash}, #{analysisVersion}, #{chunkIndex}, #{unitType}, #{unitStart}, #{unitEnd}, #{printedPageStart}, #{printedPageEnd}, #{sectionLabel}, #{displayTitle}, #{rolesJson}, #{taskText}, #{excerpt}, #{assignmentCue}, #{assignmentQuote}, #{dateCandidatesJson}, #{dedupeKey}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_sections WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM material_sections WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash = #{fileHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY unit_start ASC, unit_end ASC, section_id ASC
SELECT * FROM material_sections WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY material_id ASC, unit_start ASC, section_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE material_sections SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash <> #{keepHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE material_sections SET excerpt = NULL, task_text = NULL, assignment_quote = NULL WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId}
